versions.subject: Add thedfirreport Diavol Ransomware
versions.detection:
selection_tools:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'sqlcmd '
        - 'sqlcmd.exe'
selection_query:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'SELECT'
        - 'TOP'
        - '[VeeamBackup].[dbo].[Credentials]'
condition: all of selection*
